company_name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited
business_activity: Coastal port network and transhipment hub operations

evidence.reference: Clauses 3-12 (Cabotage regime, coastal vessel licensing & National Coastal Strategic Plan)
evidence.claim: Provides a dedicated statutory framework for domestic coastal trade, relaxes cabotage licensing requirements for coastal vessels, and mandates port priority for coastal cargo movements.

evidence.reference: APSEZ Annual Report 2023-24 (Coastal Port Network & Transhipment Hub at Vizhinjam)
evidence.claim: APSEZ operates commercial deepwater ports on east and west coasts (Mundra, Krishnapatnam, Gangavaram, Ennore, Vizhinjam) directly benefiting from coastal shipping promotion and domestic transhipment.

missing_information: Coastal cargo tonnage growth targets at Vizhinjam and Krishnapatnam.

evidence.reference: Clauses 7-14 (Promotion of coastal container movement & intermodal integration)
evidence.claim: Incentivises domestic multi-modal transport integration combining coastal shipping with inland rail freight corridors.

evidence.reference: CONCOR Annual Report 2023-24 (Coastal Shipping Business Segment)
evidence.claim: CONCOR runs dedicated coastal container shipping services connecting western ports to southern and eastern ports as an alternative to long-haul road freight.

missing_information: Cost differential between coastal container shipping and electrified railway haulage.
